units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on II Kings 3:19">Targ. II Kings III, 19</cite>, v. <cite ref="I00555"><he>טְמַם</he></cite>.—
B. Kam. 50ᵃ עד דטָאִים ליה (Ms. M. אָטֵים Af., v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) until he fills it up.
<cite ref="Eruvin 79a:5">Erub. 79ᵃ</cite> <he>למִיטַּיְּימֵיה קאי</he> the intention is that it be filled up (with the pebbles).
